revisions.label: Initial V4 Hazelwood Release
revisions.notes: Baseline snapshot. V4 extraction live with 12-section Hazelwood run sheet format, ALL CAPS output, order number fallback for Eastman Credit Union & Clear Choice Abstracting. V1 uses same prompt as V4. V2 deprecated from UI.

revisions.label: V7 July 2026 Rule Update
revisions.notes: V7 rules updated: tax info merged into ORDER INFORMATION (no standalone section), IN/OUT SALE removed from chain entries, life estate format changed to list only actual grantees with NOTES explanation, Names Searched restricted to direct chain + heirs with compact comma-separated format, outsales require full copy-and-paste block when deed is included, multi-parcel order support, maturity/MIN rules, new quality control checks.
